title: H6: rebuild Observer from stored GroupInfo and tree
description: Refines .4.14. After restart each room's Observer is rebuilt with a fresh in-memory mimi_mls Store via Observer::from_group_info(stored GroupInfo, stored ratchet tree) (which sets lifetime Skip itself), then stored pending proposals are replayed through process. No Observer::load with file storage; no atomicity needed across the two SQLite stacks. Chosen (plan recommendation approved by Mark 2026-10-18).
